mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.kind, d.status, r.title, COALESCE(e.name, a.username) AS applicant, e.avatar_key AS applicant_avatar_key, r.department_name, r.amount, d.created_at, d.updated_at, COALESCE(ue.name, ua.username) AS operator, r.submitted_at, t.id AS task_id, COALESCE(te.name, ta.username) AS assignee, te.avatar_key AS assignee_avatar_key, t.due_at, p.paid_on, p.reference FROM work_document d JOIN document_revision r ON r.id = d.current_revision_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.owner_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN account ua ON ua.id = d.updated_by LEFT JOIN employee ue ON ue.id = ua.employee_id LEFT JOIN approval_task t ON t.revision_id = r.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN account ta ON ta.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN employee te ON te.id = ta.employee_id LEFT JOIN expense_payment p ON p.document_id = d.id
mapper.select: WHERE d.owner_id = #{owner} ORDER BY d.id DESC
